name: Update Conference Krakow 2027
description: .NET developer conference with cloud, security, AI and Blazor tracks
note: Hybrid (on-site or live-stream); English; on-site 560 EUR, live-stream 390 EUR, current price tier ends 31 Jan 2027
details:
Update Conference Krakow is a .NET developer conference ("World-class .NET developer conference in Poland") with tracks on .NET, cloud, security, AI and Blazor.

The official site confirms 2-3 June 2027 at the Fabryczna Conference Centre (CKF_13), Fabryczna 13, Kraków. It is hybrid: attend on-site or watch the live-stream of all sessions via the Update Now portal. Current prices: on-site ticket 560 EUR, live-stream individual 390 EUR, live-stream team (up to 4) 1,170 EUR; the current price tier ends 31 January 2027.
